summary.headline: BEL Q1 FY27 revenue rose 25.27% to INR 5,533 crore and PAT 8.17% to INR 1,048 crore; order book INR 72,258 crore.
summary.overview: Revenue from operations grew 25.27% YoY to INR 5,533 crore, while PBT rose 8.81% to INR 1,403 crore and PAT rose 8.17% to INR 1,048 crore. Cumulative Q1 EBITDA margin was 25.83% and EPS was INR 1.43 versus INR 1.33. Order inflow was lean at INR 3,754 crore, which management attributed to timing, since FY26 year-end orders spilled into April. Management reiterated FY27 guidance of 15% revenue growth, 21-23% EBITDA margin (with a 28% year-end claim), and over INR 55,000 crore order inflow including QRSAM.

segments.name: Defence platforms by service
segments.commentary: Army, Navy and Air Force each about 30% of the order book, with defence at roughly 90% of the total. Major order book items include Electronic Fuze (Army), LRSAM (Navy), LCA LRUs, Ashwini Radar and Mi-17 V5 EW suite (Air Force), and BMP-2 upgrade.

segments.name: Export
segments.commentary: Export order book about USD 465 million; internal FY27 export guidance around USD 300 million; target 10% of revenue from exports within five years.

segments.name: Counter-drone / DEW
segments.commentary: Focus on high-power laser and microwave DEW hard-kill systems; about 80% of 2 kW laser DEW orders from the last three years already supplied. Microwave DEW prototype ready with DRDO, still under evaluation.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue growth guidance of 15%, which management said it is confident to meet or exceed.
FY27 EBITDA margin guidance of 21-23% in the closing remarks; management also said year-end margin will cross 28%. Quarterly margin may vary between 25% and 31% on product mix.
FY27 order inflow guidance of over INR 55,000 crore including QRSAM (about INR 30,000 crore QRSAM, about INR 15,000 crore platform orders, rest base orders).
R&D spend above INR 2,200 crore and capex above INR 1,200 crore for FY27.
Defence to non-defence business mix of about 90:10.
Employee cost to turnover expected to stay around 12% in coming years despite wage revision from January 2027; provision for January-March 2027 in FY27.
Indigenisation target of zero import of modules and sub-modules within five years.
capex_capacity: Capex of over INR 1,200 crore planned for FY27, mainly production infrastructure and capacity enhancement.
R&D budget above INR 2,200 crore allocated for FY27 for niche technology, indigenisation and collaborative R&D.
AMCA: RFP submission date moved by two months to 27 August 2026; response with L&T to be ready by mid-August.
demand_pricing: Order inflow was lean in Q1 because FY26 year-end orders slipped into April; management said Q1 inflow of about INR 307 crore was in line with its plan.
QRSAM (Army and Air Force, about INR 30,000 crore) expected by September 2026, pending CCS approval; procedural delays acknowledged.
Project Kusha: BEL expects an order of INR 40,000 crore-plus for the program, with a minimum of INR 28,000-29,000 crore for BEL; RFP for commercial activity still a long way off after DRDO testing.

Platform orders of around INR 15,000 crore expected in FY27 (NGC or P75I, with more than 50% probability of both); Shatrughat and Samaghat about INR 9,000 crore, Shakti Phase 4 about INR 2,000 crore, HAMMER about INR 2,500 crore, expected in 3-6 months.
Netra Mk2: BEL lost the system integrator role to Adani Defence (L1), but expects subsystem supply (radar, EW, data links).
Management attributed the Q1 margin decline to product mix, not input cost; material cost typically 50-59% of revenue.

qa_highlights.question: Why was Q1 order inflow lean YoY and when will QRSAM come?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said FY26 year-end orders spilled into April, Q1 inflow was in line with plan, and QRSAM is expected by September 2026 pending CCS approval, with all BEL inputs complete.

qa_highlights.question: Receivables, cash flow and margin decline drivers?
qa_highlights.answer: Receivable days fell to about 140 from 176 at March 2026. Margin variation was attributed to product mix, not input costs; full-year EBITDA margin of 28% was maintained.

qa_highlights.question: Impact of Tejas LRU delivery timing on revenue?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said LRU supply is ahead of HAL's contract schedule; any HAL slowdown could shift INR 200-300 crore of turnover by a few months, below 1% of the INR 30,000 crore plan.

qa_highlights.question: LRSAM execution and FY27 revenue contributors?
qa_highlights.answer: About INR 3,000 crore LRSAM balance remains, of which about INR 2,100 crore is planned for FY27. Other FY27 contributors include Akash Army (about INR 1,200 crore), D-29 EW, MPR Arudhra, BMP-2 upgrade and LCA LRUs (INR 500-1,000 crore each).

qa_highlights.question: Pay commission impact on margins?
qa_highlights.answer: Wage revision due from 1 January 2027; FY27 will carry a three-month provision. Employee cost to turnover expected to stay around 12%.

qa_highlights.question: Will margins hold with higher R&D and what is indigenisation?
qa_highlights.answer: Management expects R&D rising towards 8% of revenue to support margins through indigenisation; it targets zero import of modules within five years.

risks_watch: QRSAM and platform order timing depends on CCS approvals; management has already slipped the timeline from March to September 2026.
Order inflow reached INR 3,754 crore in Q1; full-year inflow target of INR 55,000 crore needs a steep ramp.
Competitive loss of Netra Mk2 SI role to Adani Defence signals private-sector pressure in system integration.
Quarterly EBITDA margin volatility (25-31% range) from product mix; material cost swings of 3-4 percentage points.
Wage revision from January 2027 and whether it is settled or fully provided.
Tejas engine bottleneck at HAL could delay LRU offtake.
summary.management_tone: Confident and reassuring on full-year guidance and order pipeline, but evasive on exact timelines for QRSAM, AMCA RFP extension and Netra, and on quarterly margin drivers, which it attributed to product mix.
key_quotes: So, as such, there is nothing to worry. We are definitely going to meet the guidance given about the order inflow for this year.
Definitely yes. We have variability of 25% to 31% EBITDA margins based on the product mix in quarter-to-quarter etc but at the year end, let me again assure you, we will cross 28%.
Overall, our turnover 78% to 80% comes from indigenous products and technologies.
Definitely, as I told last year also, target is 15%.
